instantiated_cells.justification: Section 13.69 expressly provides civil forfeitures and criminal penalties for principals and lobbyists who violate lobbying provisions (including acting without a license and filing falsified statements), establishing statutory penalties for disclosure violations.

The ethics commission must examine statements filed (§13.685(3)) and shall cause examinations of all required statements and may inspect supporting documents (§13.74(1)), which is a compliance review rather than a mandated regular independent third-party financial audit.
